name: University of Strathclyde

sources.title: Pre-CAS readiness check | University of Strathclyde
topics: your reasons for studying in the UK
Your course (what you'll study, key modules, skills gained)
Your future plans (career goals, course alignment)
sources.notes: Not CAS Shield: 'completed online (via Qualtrics) and includes a combination of video and written responses'; 'Approximately 15 minutes'; 'Your responses will be reviewed by the academic faculty'. Outcomes: Pass (CAS may be issued), Borderline (guidance, may progress), Unsuccessful (second opportunity may be given; failure ends progression). Search snippet: 'reflects the type of questions asked in a UKVI credibility interview, and may be asked of some applicants before visa sponsorship'. No literal questions listed, only topics.

sources.title: Student visa information | University of Strathclyde ISC
quotes: Why did you choose the University of Strathclyde International Study Centre?
Why do you want to study in the UK?
Do you plan to work in the UK?
sources.notes: International Study Centre (pathway college, Study Group) page about UKVI credibility interviews, not the main university. 'Credibility interviews normally take place in your local Visa Application Centre, via a video link ... interviewed by an ECO'. Advises research on accommodation options, costs, local area, course content.
